validator.source_text:
<scxml xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2005/07/scxml" version="1.0" datamodel="xpath" initial="a">
  <datamodel>
    <data id="count" expr="0"/>
    <data id="done" expr="false()"/>
    <data id="user"><name xmlns="">bob</name></data>
  </datamodel>
  <state id="a">
    <onentry><log expr="'it's done'"/></onentry>
    <transition event="go" target="b"/>
  </state>
  <final id="b"/>
</scxml>

diagnostics.message: xpath syntax error in `expr`: the string literal ends early at this `'`
notes: an expression that cannot be parsed raises `error.execution` whenever it is evaluated
diagnostics.help: XPath 1.0 string literals have no escape sequences: delimit a string that contains `'` with `"` (written `"` inside an attribute delimited by `"`), or build it with `concat()`
spec_references: SCXML CR 2014 §C.3 The XPath Data Model
